-- Catalog Dresser: dresses your character on execute, and again on every respawn.
-- The viewport copy (PlayerGui.List.Viewport1.WorldModel.Original) gets the same outfit, and the outfit
-- is added as a skin of its own, "Valencina Biograft", in ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Biograft.Skins
-- (the Display is no longer edited directly), together with a copy of SkinAssets.Original of the same
-- name in ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Biograft.SkinAssets (the skin's dependencies), and a BoolValue of
-- the same name in ReplicatedStorage.Modules.DatastoreScript.Data.Skins.Biograft.
print("[Biocina] script started")

	-- byte size of each embedded PNG: a file with a different size on disk is rewritten (audio is never overwritten)
	local PNG_SIZE = {
		["129622989588953.png"] = 116906,
		["116842793970817.png"] = 206216,
		["91945477891076.png"] = 345486,
	}

	local B64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
	local B64_VALUE = {}
	for i = 1, 64 do B64_VALUE[string.byte(B64, i)] = i - 1 end

	-- plain Lua base64 decoder (used when the executor has no built-in one)
	local function decodeLua(text)
		text = string.gsub(text, "[^A-Za-z0-9%+/]", "") -- drop padding and whitespace
		local out, buf, n = {}, {}, 0
		local len = #text
		local i = 1
		while i <= len do
			local a = B64_VALUE[string.byte(text, i)]
			local b = B64_VALUE[string.byte(text, i + 1)]
			local c = B64_VALUE[string.byte(text, i + 2)] -- nil at the end of the data
			local d = B64_VALUE[string.byte(text, i + 3)]
			if not a or not b then break end
			local v = a * 262144 + b * 4096 + (c or 0) * 64 + (d or 0)
			n += 1
			buf[n] = math.floor(v / 65536)
			if c then
				n += 1
				buf[n] = math.floor(v / 256) % 256
			end
			if d then
				n += 1
				buf[n] = v % 256
			end
			if n >= 4090 then
				out[#out + 1] = string.char(table.unpack(buf, 1, n))
				n = 0
			end
			i += 4
		end
		if n > 0 then out[#out + 1] = string.char(table.unpack(buf, 1, n)) end
		return table.concat(out)
	end

	local function decode(text)
		local c = crypt :: any
		local b = base64 :: any
		local fn = (c and (c.base64decode or (type(c.base64) == "table" and c.base64.decode)))
			or (base64_decode :: any) or (type(b) == "table" and b.decode)
		if fn then
			local ok, res = pcall(fn, text)
			if ok and type(res) == "string" and #res > 0 then return res end
		end
		return decodeLua(text)
	end

	if not (writefile and isfile) then
		warn("[Audio] this executor has no writefile / isfile: missing files can't be restored")
	else
		-- the files the script uses, plus anything else that was put into AUDIO_EMBED
		local names, listed = {}, {}
		for _, f in ipairs(AUDIO_FILES) do
			names[#names + 1] = f
			listed[f] = true
		end
		for f in pairs(AUDIO_EMBED) do
			if not listed[f] then names[#names + 1] = f end
		end

		local restored, missing = 0, {}
		for _, f in ipairs(names) do
			if not isfile(f) or (PNG_SIZE[f] and readfile and select(2, pcall(function() return #readfile(f) end)) ~= PNG_SIZE[f]) then
				local chunks = AUDIO_EMBED[f]
				if chunks then
					local ok, err = pcall(function()
						writefile(f, decode(table.concat(chunks)))
					end)
					if ok then
						restored += 1
						print("[Audio] restored " .. f)
					else
						warn("[Audio] couldn't write " .. f .. ": " .. tostring(err))
					end
				else
					missing[#missing + 1] = f
				end
			end
		end
		if #missing > 0 then
			warn("[Audio] missing and not embedded (run audio_packer.txt while you still have them): "
				.. table.concat(missing, ", "))
		end
		if restored > 0 then print("[Audio] restored " .. restored .. " file(s) into the workspace folder") end
	end
end

	-- body clean-up that goes with the outfit (your character, respawns, the viewport copy and the new skin)
	cleanup = {
		delete  = { "Part7.001", "Part1.001", "Part1.002", "Part5", "Part5.001" }, -- deleted
		visible = { "Right Leg", "Left Leg", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Torso" },   -- Transparency 0
		burlap  = { "Highlight6", "Horn" },                                        -- BrickColor Burlap
	},
	-- A respawned character and the viewport copy are only dressed if they contain this child, and the
	-- skin is copied from the first skin in Skins that contains it (it identifies the Biograft rig).
	-- Change it if your rig is recognised by something else.
	marker = "WeaponR",
	-- The outfit is also added as a skin of its own next to the other skins (nothing there is replaced).
	skin = {
		name = "Valencina Biograft",
		-- name of the existing skin in Skins to copy the rig from; nil = the first skin that contains `marker`
		base = "Original",
		-- entry of ClassFolders.Biograft.SkinAssets that is copied for the skin (all of its dependencies)
		assets = "Original",
		-- Value of the BoolValue added to Modules.DatastoreScript.Data.Skins.Biograft (true = the skin is owned)
		owned = true,
	},
}

-- Everything below only applies while Valencina Biograft is the equipped skin (LocalPlayer.Skin).
-- The server doesn't know this skin (it only exists on your client) and builds your character as Original, so
-- LocalPlayer.Skin never says "Valencina Biograft". Instead the pick is tracked here: the SetClass remote the
-- picker fires is hooked just below, and env.__valPicked says whether the skin you last confirmed was ours.
local function isValencina()
	local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
	local sv = lp:FindFirstChild("Skin")
	if sv and sv.Value == CONFIG.skin.name then return true end -- in case the server ever accepts it
	local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
	local cv = lp:FindFirstChild("Class")
	return env.__valPicked == true and cv ~= nil and cv.Value == "Biograft"
end

-- ReplicatedStorage.Events.SetClass:FireServer(class, skinName) is what the picker fires when you confirm.
-- Hooked once per session: remembers whether the pick was ours, and tells the server "Original" in that case.
do
	local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
	env.__valSkinName = CONFIG.skin.name
	if not env.__valSetClassHook then
		if hookmetamethod and getnamecallmethod then
			local old
			old = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", ((newcclosure or function(f) return f end) :: any)(function(self, ...)
				if getnamecallmethod() == "FireServer" and typeof(self) == "Instance"
					and self.Name == "SetClass" and not (checkcaller and checkcaller()) then
					local class, skin = ...
					if class == "Biograft" and skin == env.__valSkinName then
						env.__valPicked = true
						return old(self, class, "Original", select(3, ...))
					end
					env.__valPicked = false
				end
				return old(self, ...)
			end))
			env.__valSetClassHook = true
		else
			warn("[Skin] hookmetamethod/getnamecallmethod not available: can't tell when you pick the skin")
		end
	end
end
-- waits up to `t` seconds for the Skin value to become ours (it can lag behind the character a little)
local function waitValencina(t)
	local deadline = os.clock() + (t or 2)
	while not isValencina() and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait(0.1) end
	return isValencina()
end

-- onSkinChange(fn): fn(isNowValencina) runs every time the equipped skin switches to / away from ours
local skinHooks = {}
local function onSkinChange(fn) skinHooks[#skinHooks + 1] = fn end
do
	local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
	local token = {}
	env.__valSkinToken = token -- a second execution stops this loop
	task.spawn(function()
		local last = isValencina()
		while env.__valSkinToken == token do
			task.wait(0.25)
			local now = isValencina()
			if now ~= last then
				last = now
				for _, fn in ipairs(skinHooks) do task.spawn(fn, now) end
			end
		end
	end)
end

local Core = (function()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Core = {}
Core.state = {} -- item -> { mesh, weld, meshId }
Core.originals = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local MESH_ATTR = "PwieMesh"
local CANVAS_SCALE = 4
local INSET = 0.5

-- Regions read from the 585x559 classic clothing template: { offsetX, offsetY, width, height }
local TORSO = {
	Top    = { 231, 8,   128, 64  },
	Right  = { 165, 74,  64,  128 },
	Front  = { 231, 74,  128, 128 },
	Left   = { 361, 74,  64,  128 },
	Back   = { 427, 74,  128, 128 },
	Bottom = { 231, 204, 128, 64  },
}
local RIGHT_LIMB = {
	Top    = { 217, 289, 64,  64  },
	Right  = { 19,  355, 64,  128 },
	Front  = { 85,  355, 64,  128 },
	Left   = { 151, 355, 64,  128 },
	Back   = { 217, 355, 64,  128 },
	Bottom = { 217, 485, 64,  64  },
}
local LEFT_LIMB = {
	Top    = { 308, 289, 64,  64  },
	Right  = { 308, 355, 64,  128 },
	Front  = { 374, 355, 64,  128 },
	Left   = { 440, 355, 64,  128 },
	Back   = { 506, 355, 64,  128 },
	Bottom = { 308, 485, 64,  64  },
}
local SHIRT_REGIONS = { ["Torso"] = TORSO, ["Right Arm"] = RIGHT_LIMB, ["Left Arm"] = LEFT_LIMB }
local PANTS_REGIONS = { ["Right Leg"] = RIGHT_LIMB, ["Left Leg"] = LEFT_LIMB }

local function getChar()
	return LocalPlayer.Character
end

-- ===== weld targets =====
-- path = a child of the character ("Head", "WeaponR") or a dotted path into it ("WeaponR.Blade").
-- A part is used directly; a model is welded through its PrimaryPart, or its first part.
local function resolveTarget(char, path)
	local inst = char
	for seg in string.gmatch(path, "[^%.]+") do
		inst = inst and inst:FindFirstChild(seg)
	end
	if not inst then return nil end
	if inst:IsA("BasePart") then return inst end
	if inst:IsA("Model") then
		if inst.PrimaryPart then return inst.PrimaryPart end
		for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") and not d:GetAttribute(MESH_ATTR) then
				return d
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function waitTarget(char, path, timeout)
	local started = os.clock()
	local part = resolveTarget(char, path)
	while not part and os.clock() - started < timeout and char.Parent do
		task.wait(0.1)
		part = resolveTarget(char, path)
	end
	return part
end

-- ===== meshes (accessories as welded MeshParts) =====
local function offsetCF(item)
	local r = item.Rotation or Vector3.new()
	return CFrame.new(item.Offset or Vector3.new())
		* CFrame.fromOrientation(math.rad(r.X), math.rad(r.Y), math.rad(r.Z))
end

local function createMesh(item)
	local mesh
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(item.MeshId)
	end)
	if ok then
		mesh = result
	else
		warn(item.Name .. ": CreateMeshPartAsync failed (" .. tostring(result) .. "), trying fallback")
		mesh = Instance.new("MeshPart")
		local ok2, err2 = pcall(function()
			mesh.MeshId = item.MeshId
		end)
		if not ok2 then
			mesh:Destroy()
			error("could not set MeshId: " .. tostring(err2), 0)
		end
	end
	mesh.Name = item.Name
	mesh:SetAttribute(MESH_ATTR, true)
	mesh.TextureID = item.TextureID or ""
	mesh.Size = item.Size
	mesh.Transparency = item.Transparency or 0
	mesh.Anchored = false
	mesh.CanCollide = false
	mesh.CanTouch = false
	mesh.CanQuery = false
	mesh.Massless = true
	mesh.RootPriority = -127
	mesh.CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box
	return mesh
end

function Core.detach(item)
	local st = Core.state[item]
	if st then
		pcall(function() st.mesh:Destroy() end)
		Core.state[item] = nil
	end
end

function Core.attach(item)
	local char = getChar()
	if not char then error("no character", 0) end
	local part = waitTarget(char, item.Part, 5)
	if not part then
		error("can't find a part to weld to at '" .. tostring(item.Part) .. "'", 0)
	end
	Core.detach(item)
	local old = part:FindFirstChild(item.Name) -- already on the character (e.g. it was spawned from the new skin)
	if old and old:GetAttribute(MESH_ATTR) then old:Destroy() end

	local mesh = createMesh(item)
	if getChar() ~= char or not part.Parent then
		mesh:Destroy()
		return
	end

	local cf = offsetCF(item)
	mesh.CFrame = part.CFrame * cf

	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = item.Name .. "Weld"
	weld.Part0 = part
	weld.Part1 = mesh
	weld.C0 = cf
	weld.Parent = mesh

	mesh.Parent = part
	Core.state[item] = { mesh = mesh, weld = weld, meshId = item.MeshId }
end

-- ===== weapon model transparency =====
function Core.applyWeapon(name, value)
	local char = getChar()
	local model = char and char:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not model then return false end
	local list = model:GetDescendants()
	table.insert(list, model)
	for _, d in ipairs(list) do
		if (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal")) and not d:GetAttribute(MESH_ATTR) then
			if value == nil then
				local original = Core.originals[d]
				if original ~= nil then
					d.Transparency = original
					Core.originals[d] = nil
				end
			else
				if Core.originals[d] == nil then
					Core.originals[d] = d.Transparency
				end
				if d.Transparency ~= value then
					d.Transparency = value
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- ===== clothing =====
local function applyFace(part, face, region, image)
	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Name = "Clothing_" .. face
	gui.Face = Enum.NormalId[face]
	gui.Adornee = part
	gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
	gui.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(region[3] * CANVAS_SCALE, region[4] * CANVAS_SCALE)
	gui.LightInfluence = 1

	local label = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Image = image
	label.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(region[1] + INSET, region[2] + INSET)
	label.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(region[3] - INSET * 2, region[4] - INSET * 2)
	label.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	label.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(region[3] * CANVAS_SCALE, region[4] * CANVAS_SCALE)
	label.Parent = gui

	gui.Parent = part
end

local function regionsFor(kind)
	return kind == "Shirt" and SHIRT_REGIONS or PANTS_REGIONS
end

function Core.clearClothing(kind)
	local char = getChar()
	if not char then return end
	for partName in pairs(regionsFor(kind)) do
		local part = char:FindFirstChild(partName)
		if part then
			for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("SurfaceGui") and string.sub(child.Name, 1, 9) == "Clothing_" then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function Core.setClothing(kind, image)
	local char = getChar()
	if not char then error("no character", 0) end
	Core.clearClothing(kind)
	for partName, faces in pairs(regionsFor(kind)) do
		local part = char:WaitForChild(partName, 5)
		if part then
			for face, region in pairs(faces) do
				applyFace(part, face, region, image)
			end
		else
			warn("missing part " .. partName .. " (clothing is made for R6 rigs)")
		end
	end
end

function Core.applyAll(cfg)
	local char = getChar()
	if not char then return end
	char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	char:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
	for _, item in ipairs(cfg.meshes) do
		local ok, err = pcall(Core.attach, item)
		if not ok then warn("mesh " .. tostring(item.Name) .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
	if cfg.shirt then
		local ok, err = pcall(Core.setClothing, "Shirt", cfg.shirt)
		if not ok then warn("shirt: " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
	if cfg.pants then
		local ok, err = pcall(Core.setClothing, "Pants", cfg.pants)
		if not ok then warn("pants: " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
	for name, value in pairs(cfg.weapons or {}) do
		if not Core.applyWeapon(name, value) then
			warn("weapon model not found: " .. name)
		end
	end
end

-- helpers shared with the respawn / viewport / skin code further down
Core.createMesh = createMesh
Core.offsetCF = offsetCF
Core.applyFace = applyFace
Core.resolveTarget = resolveTarget
Core.SHIRT_REGIONS = SHIRT_REGIONS
Core.PANTS_REGIONS = PANTS_REGIONS
Core.MESH_ATTR = MESH_ATTR

return Core
end)()

-- ===== run once =====
task.spawn(function()
	local char = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end
	char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	char:WaitForChild("Torso", 10)
	if not waitValencina(2) then return end -- another skin is equipped: leave the character alone

	-- 1. delete these parts
	for _, name in ipairs(CONFIG.cleanup.delete) do
		local p = char:FindFirstChild(name)
		if p then
			p:Destroy()
		else
			warn("not found, skipped: " .. name)
		end
	end

	-- 2. make the body parts visible
	for _, name in ipairs(CONFIG.cleanup.visible) do
		local p = char:FindFirstChild(name)
		if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Transparency = 0
		else
			warn("not found, skipped: " .. name)
		end
	end

	-- 3. set these parts to Burlap
	for _, name in ipairs(CONFIG.cleanup.burlap) do
		local p = char:FindFirstChild(name)
		if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Burlap")
		else
			warn("not found or not a part, skipped: " .. name)
		end
	end

	-- 4. apply the outfit (meshes, pants, weapon transparency)
	Core.applyAll(CONFIG)
end)

-- ===== Respawn, viewport copy and the new skin =====
-- The outfit above is put on a character (or a copy of one) only if it contains CONFIG.marker, so other
-- classes and the lobby character are left alone.
--   * Respawn:  every new character of yours is dressed the same way (instantly, from preloaded meshes)
--   * Viewport: PlayerGui.List.Viewport1.WorldModel.Original (+ the other ViewportFrame clones of it)
--   * Skin:     "Valencina Biograft" is added to ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Biograft.Skins
-- ViewportFrames don't draw SurfaceGuis, so there the pants are drawn with Decals, and the meshes are
-- anchored and moved to their part every frame (no welds / physics inside a viewport).
-- Runs in its own scope, and a second execution replaces this one instead of stacking.
do
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G

if env.__dressConns then
	for _, c in ipairs(env.__dressConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
end
local conns = {}
env.__dressConns = conns
local run = {}
env.__dressRun = run
local function isCurrentRun() return env.__dressRun == run end
local function keep(conn) table.insert(conns, conn) return conn end

local MARKER = CONFIG.marker
local CLEAN = CONFIG.cleanup
local BURLAP = BrickColor.new("Burlap")
local VIEWPORT_TEMPLATE_SIZE = Vector2.new(585, 559) -- size of the shirt/pants template atlas
local VIEWPORT_TEXTURE_V_SIGN = -1                   -- Texture fallback only: flip to 1 if it looks vertically shifted

local function isAlive(inst)
	return inst.Parent ~= nil and inst:IsDescendantOf(game)
end

-- ===== mesh templates (loaded once in the background, then plain Clones are instant) =====
local templates = {}
for _, item in ipairs(CONFIG.meshes) do
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, mesh = pcall(Core.createMesh, item)
		if ok and mesh then
			templates[item.Name] = mesh
		else
			warn("[Dress] couldn't preload " .. tostring(item.Name) .. ": " .. tostring(mesh))
		end
	end)
end

-- ===== viewport helpers =====
local viewportSources = {}
local function getViewportTemplate(image)
	if viewportSources[image] ~= nil then
		return viewportSources[image] or nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local assetId = tonumber(string.match(image, "%d+"))
		if not assetId then error("no asset id in " .. tostring(image)) end
		return AssetService:CreateEditableImageAsync(Content.fromAssetId(assetId))
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Dress] viewport clothing: EditableImage unavailable (" .. tostring(result) .. "), using Texture fallback")
	end
	viewportSources[image] = ok and result or false
	return ok and result or nil
end

local function cropViewportRegion(source, region)
	local size = Vector2.new(region[3], region[4])
	local ok, cropped = pcall(function()
		local img = AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = size })
		local okBuffer = pcall(function()
			img:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, size, source:ReadPixelsBuffer(Vector2.new(region[1], region[2]), size))
		end)
		if not okBuffer then
			img:DrawImage(Vector2.new(-region[1], -region[2]), source, Enum.ImageCombineType.Overwrite)
		end
		return img
	end)
	return ok and cropped or nil
end

local function viewportFaceSize(part, face)
	local s = part.Size
	if face == "Front" or face == "Back" then
		return s.X, s.Y
	elseif face == "Left" or face == "Right" then
		return s.Z, s.Y
	end
	return s.X, s.Z
end

local function applyViewportFace(part, face, region, image, source)
	local name = "DressClothing_" .. face
	local old = part:FindFirstChild(name)
	if old then old:Destroy() end

	if source then
		local cropped = cropViewportRegion(source, region)
		if cropped then
			local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
			decal.Name = name
			decal.Face = Enum.NormalId[face]
			local okSet = pcall(function()
				decal.TextureContent = Content.fromObject(cropped)
			end)
			if okSet then
				decal.Parent = part
				return
			end
			decal:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- fallback: a Texture sized so that exactly one template region fills the face
	local faceW, faceH = viewportFaceSize(part, face)
	local tex = Instance.new("Texture")
	tex.Name = name
	tex.Texture = image
	tex.Face = Enum.NormalId[face]
	tex.StudsPerTileU = faceW * VIEWPORT_TEMPLATE_SIZE.X / region[3]
	tex.StudsPerTileV = faceH * VIEWPORT_TEMPLATE_SIZE.Y / region[4]
	tex.OffsetStudsU = -(region[1] / VIEWPORT_TEMPLATE_SIZE.X) * tex.StudsPerTileU
	tex.OffsetStudsV = VIEWPORT_TEXTURE_V_SIGN * (region[2] / VIEWPORT_TEMPLATE_SIZE.Y) * tex.StudsPerTileV
	tex.Parent = part
end

-- meshes inside a ViewportFrame are anchored and moved to their part every frame
local followList = {}
local followed = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local function follow(mesh, part, cf)
	if followed[mesh] then return end
	followed[mesh] = true
	mesh.Anchored = true
	mesh.CFrame = part.CFrame * cf
	table.insert(followList, { mesh = mesh, part = part, cf = cf })
end

keep(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	for i = #followList, 1, -1 do
		local e = followList[i]
		if e.mesh.Parent and e.part.Parent then
			e.mesh.CFrame = e.part.CFrame * e.cf
		else
			table.remove(followList, i)
		end
	end
end))

-- The game clones the viewport model into other ViewportFrames too (a silhouette, for example). Those
-- clones carry our meshes, anchored and frozen, so every one of them is followed to its part as well.
local cfgByName = {}
for _, item in ipairs(CONFIG.meshes) do cfgByName[item.Name] = item end

local function followViewportClone(inst)
	if not inst:IsA("MeshPart") or followed[inst] then return end
	local item = cfgByName[inst.Name]
	local part = inst.Parent
	if not item or not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or not inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ViewportFrame") then return end
	local a, b = string.match(inst.MeshId, "%d+"), string.match(item.MeshId, "%d+")
	if a ~= nil and a ~= b then return end -- not ours
	follow(inst, part, Core.offsetCF(item))
end

-- ===== dressing (safe to run again: only adds what is missing) =====
local function newState()
	return { clothed = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) }
end

local function dressClothing(target, regionsByPart, image, state, viewport)
	local source = viewport and getViewportTemplate(image) or nil
	for partName, faces in pairs(regionsByPart) do
		local part = target:FindFirstChild(partName)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and not state.clothed[part] then
			state.clothed[part] = true
			for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("SurfaceGui") and string.sub(child.Name, 1, 9) == "Clothing_" then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
			for face, region in pairs(faces) do
				if viewport then
					applyViewportFace(part, face, region, image, source)
				else
					Core.applyFace(part, face, region, image)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function dressMesh(target, item, viewport)
	local part = Core.resolveTarget(target, item.Part)
	if not part or part:FindFirstChild(item.Name) then return end

	local mesh
	local template = templates[item.Name]
	if template then
		mesh = template:Clone()
	else
		local ok, made = pcall(Core.createMesh, item) -- still loading: build it now (this yields)
		mesh = ok and made or nil
		if not mesh or not part.Parent or part:FindFirstChild(item.Name) then
			if mesh then mesh:Destroy() end
			return
		end
	end

	local cf = Core.offsetCF(item)
	mesh.CFrame = part.CFrame * cf
	if viewport then
		mesh.Anchored = true
		mesh.Parent = part
		follow(mesh, part, cf)
	else
		local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
		weld.Name = item.Name .. "Weld"
		weld.Part0 = part
		weld.Part1 = mesh
		weld.C0 = cf
		weld.Parent = mesh -- welded BEFORE it is parented, so it joins already attached
		mesh.Parent = part
	end
end

local function dressModel(target, state, viewport)
	-- same steps as the run-once block above
	for _, name in ipairs(CLEAN.delete) do
		local p = target:FindFirstChild(name)
		if p then p:Destroy() end
	end
	for _, name in ipairs(CLEAN.visible) do
		local p = target:FindFirstChild(name)
		if p and p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency ~= 0 then p.Transparency = 0 end
	end
	for _, name in ipairs(CLEAN.burlap) do
		local p = target:FindFirstChild(name)
		if p and p:IsA("BasePart") and p.BrickColor ~= BURLAP then p.BrickColor = BURLAP end
	end

	if CONFIG.shirt then dressClothing(target, Core.SHIRT_REGIONS, CONFIG.shirt, state, viewport) end
	if CONFIG.pants then dressClothing(target, Core.PANTS_REGIONS, CONFIG.pants, state, viewport) end

	for _, item in ipairs(CONFIG.meshes) do
		dressMesh(target, item, viewport)
	end

	for name, value in pairs(CONFIG.weapons or {}) do
		local model = target:FindFirstChild(name)
		if model then
			local list = model:GetDescendants()
			table.insert(list, model)
			for _, d in ipairs(list) do
				if (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal")) and not d:GetAttribute(Core.MESH_ATTR) and d.Transparency ~= value then
					d.Transparency = value
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Dresses `target` now, and again whenever something new shows up in it (parts that arrive a little
-- later). Refreshes never overlap, and it stops by itself when the target goes away.
local function watchModel(target, viewport, label)
	local state = newState()
	local running, again = false, false

	local function refresh()
		if running then again = true return end
		running = true
		repeat
			again = false
			if not isCurrentRun() or not isAlive(target) then break end
			local ok, err = pcall(dressModel, target, state, viewport)
			if not ok then warn("[Dress] " .. label .. " failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
		until not again
		running = false
	end

	refresh()

	local pending = false
	target.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
		if pending then return end
		pending = true
		task.defer(function()
			pending = false
			refresh()
		end)
	end)
end

-- ===== respawn =====
local firstChar = LocalPlayer.Character -- the run-once block above dresses this one

local function dressRespawned(char)
	if char == firstChar or not isCurrentRun() then return end
	if not char:WaitForChild(MARKER, 15) then
		warn("[Dress] respawn: " .. char:GetFullName() .. " has no " .. MARKER .. ", left alone")
		return
	end
	if not waitValencina(2) then return end -- another skin is equipped
	print("[Dress] respawn: dressing " .. char:GetFullName())
	watchModel(char, false, "respawn")
end

keep(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.spawn(dressRespawned, char)
end))

-- ===== New skin: ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Biograft.Skins["Valencina Biograft"] =====
-- Instead of editing the Display, the outfit becomes a skin of its own that shows up next to the others.
-- It is a copy of an existing skin (so it has the same rig / structure the game expects) dressed like
-- your character, plus a copy of SkinAssets.Original under the same name in SkinAssets (everything the
-- skin depends on). Nothing that already exists in Skins or SkinAssets is touched, removed or replaced.
local SKIN_TAG = "ValencinaSkin"

local function findBiograftFolder(last) -- ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Biograft.<last>
	local folder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	for _, name in ipairs({ "ClassFolders", "Biograft", last }) do
		folder = folder:WaitForChild(name, 10)
		if not folder then return nil end
	end
	return folder
end

-- ===== custom sounds for the skin's assets =====
-- Sets the SoundId of `inst` (a Sound, or every Sound inside it) to a local file loaded with getcustomasset.
local function setSoundFile(inst, file)
	local ok, id = pcall(getcustomasset, file)
	if not (ok and id) then
		warn("[Skin] getcustomasset failed for " .. file .. ": " .. tostring(id))
		return 0
	end
	local count = 0
	local list = inst:GetDescendants()
	table.insert(list, inst)
	for _, d in ipairs(list) do
		if d:IsA("Sound") then
			d.SoundId = id
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

-- Forces PlaybackSpeed (and the legacy Pitch / any PitchShiftSoundEffect) of a Sound to 1 and keeps it there
local function lockSpeed(sound)
	local function force()
		if sound.PlaybackSpeed ~= 1 then sound.PlaybackSpeed = 1 end
		pcall(function() sound.Pitch = 1 end)
		for _, c in ipairs(sound:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("PitchShiftSoundEffect") and c.Octave ~= 1 then c.Octave = 1 end
		end
	end
	force()
	sound:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PlaybackSpeed"):Connect(force)
	pcall(function() sound:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Pitch"):Connect(force) end)
	sound.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
		if c:IsA("PitchShiftSoundEffect") then
			force()
			c:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Octave"):Connect(force)
		end
	end)
	for _, c in ipairs(sound:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("PitchShiftSoundEffect") then c:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Octave"):Connect(force) end
	end
end

-- ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Biograft.SkinAssets.Original: the game reads its assets from here, so
-- MVPSound -> valhaha.wav (playback speed locked to 1) and Fanfare (copied from Subspace) go in here.
-- Done before the skin's assets are copied, so the Valencina Biograft copy inherits both.
local addFanfare

local function prepareOriginal()
	local assets = findBiograftFolder("SkinAssets")
	local original = assets and assets:WaitForChild("Original", 10)
	if not original then
		warn("[Skin] couldn't find ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Biograft.SkinAssets.Original")
		return
	end
	if not isCurrentRun() then return end

	local mvp = original:WaitForChild("MVPSound", 10)
	if mvp then
		if setSoundFile(mvp, "valhaha.wav") == 0 then
			warn("[Skin] MVPSound holds no Sound to replace")
		end
		for _, d in ipairs(mvp:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("Sound") then lockSpeed(d) end
		end
		if mvp:IsA("Sound") then lockSpeed(mvp) end
		print("[Skin] MVPSound -> valhaha.wav, playback speed 1")
	else
		warn("[Skin] couldn't find SkinAssets.Original.MVPSound")
	end

	addFanfare(original)
end

-- Puts a copy of ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Subspace.SkinAssets.Original.Fanfare inside `parent`
-- (SkinAssets.Original, which the game reads), with its sound replaced by valfanfare.wav
addFanfare = function(parent)
	local source = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	for _, n in ipairs({ "ClassFolders", "Subspace", "SkinAssets", "Original", "Fanfare" }) do
		source = source:WaitForChild(n, 10)
		if not source then
			warn("[Skin] couldn't find ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Subspace.SkinAssets.Original.Fanfare (stopped at " .. n .. ")")
			return
		end
	end
	local fanfare = source:Clone()
	if not fanfare then
		warn("[Skin] couldn't copy Fanfare (not archivable)")
		return
	end
	fanfare.Name = "Fanfare"
	if setSoundFile(fanfare, "valfanfare.wav") == 0 then
		warn("[Skin] the copied Fanfare holds no Sound to replace")
	end
	local old = parent:FindFirstChild("Fanfare") -- the copy of Original may already have one
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	fanfare.Parent = parent
	print("[Skin] added Fanfare (valfanfare.wav) to " .. parent:GetFullName())
end

-- the skin that is copied: CONFIG.skin.base if set, else the first skin that contains the marker
local function pickBaseSkin(skins)
	if CONFIG.skin.base then
		return skins:FindFirstChild(CONFIG.skin.base)
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(skins:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Model") and not child:GetAttribute(SKIN_TAG) and child:FindFirstChild(MARKER) then
			return child
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function addSkin()
	local skins = findBiograftFolder("Skins")
	if not skins then
		warn("[Skin] couldn't find ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Biograft.Skins")
		return
	end
	if not isCurrentRun() then return end
	local name = CONFIG.skin.name

	-- a copy made by an earlier run of this script is replaced; a skin that isn't ours is never touched
	for _, child in ipairs(skins:GetChildren()) do
		if child.Name == name then
			if child:GetAttribute(SKIN_TAG) then
				child:Destroy()
			else
				warn("[Skin] Skins already has something called '" .. name .. "' that isn't ours: left alone, no skin added")
				return
			end
		end
	end

	local base = pickBaseSkin(skins)
	local skin
	if base then
		skin = base:Clone()
	else
		-- no skin to copy: copy your (already dressed) character instead, without its scripts
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		skin = char and char:Clone()
		if skin then
			for _, d in ipairs(skin:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then d:Destroy() end
			end
		end
	end
	if not skin then
		warn("[Skin] nothing to copy: no skin containing " .. MARKER .. " in Skins, and no character")
		return
	end

	skin.Name = name
	skin:SetAttribute(SKIN_TAG, true)

	dressModel(skin, newState(), false) -- dressed before the game can see it
	if not isCurrentRun() then
		skin:Destroy()
		return
	end
	-- the picker (ChooseScript.orderTable) sorts by the Order attribute; the copy inherited the base skin's, so
	-- give it its own, one past the highest existing one
	local maxOrder = 0
	for _, s in ipairs(skins:GetChildren()) do
		local o = s:GetAttribute("Order")
		if type(o) == "number" and o > maxOrder then maxOrder = o end
	end
	skin:SetAttribute("Order", maxOrder + 1)
	skin.Parent = skins
	print("[Skin] added '" .. name .. "' to " .. skins:GetFullName()
		.. (base and (" (copy of " .. base.Name .. ")") or " (copy of your character)"))
end

-- ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Biograft.SkinAssets["Valencina Biograft"]: a copy of SkinAssets.Original
local function addSkinAssets()
	local assets = findBiograftFolder("SkinAssets")
	if not assets then
		warn("[Skin] couldn't find ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Biograft.SkinAssets")
		return
	end
	if not isCurrentRun() then return end
	local name = CONFIG.skin.name

	-- a copy made by an earlier run of this script is replaced; anything else with that name is never touched
	for _, child in ipairs(assets:GetChildren()) do
		if child.Name == name then
			if child:GetAttribute(SKIN_TAG) then
				child:Destroy()
			else
				warn("[Skin] SkinAssets already has something called '" .. name .. "' that isn't ours: left alone")
				return
			end
		end
	end

	local source = assets:FindFirstChild(CONFIG.skin.assets)
	local copy = source and source:Clone() -- everything inside it comes along
	if not copy then
		warn("[Skin] couldn't copy SkinAssets." .. tostring(CONFIG.skin.assets))
		return
	end
	copy.Name = name
	copy:SetAttribute(SKIN_TAG, true)
	-- (the copy already carries Original's MVPSound and Fanfare)
	local copiedMVP = copy:FindFirstChild("MVPSound")
	if copiedMVP then
		for _, d in ipairs(copiedMVP:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("Sound") then lockSpeed(d) end
		end
		if copiedMVP:IsA("Sound") then lockSpeed(copiedMVP) end
	end
	copy.Parent = assets
	print("[Skin] added '" .. name .. "' to " .. assets:GetFullName() .. " (copy of " .. source.Name .. ")")
end

-- ReplicatedStorage.Modules.DatastoreScript.Data.Skins.Biograft["Valencina Biograft"]: a BoolValue
local function addSkinFlag()
	local folder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	for _, n in ipairs({ "Modules", "DatastoreScript", "Data", "Skins", "Biograft" }) do
		folder = folder:WaitForChild(n, 10)
		if not folder then
			warn("[Skin] couldn't find ReplicatedStorage.Modules.DatastoreScript.Data.Skins.Biograft (stopped at " .. n .. ")")
			return
		end
	end
	if not isCurrentRun() then return end
	local name = CONFIG.skin.name

	-- one made by an earlier run of this script is replaced; anything else with that name is never touched
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child.Name == name then
			if child:GetAttribute(SKIN_TAG) then
				child:Destroy()
			else
				warn("[Skin] Data.Skins.Biograft already has something called '" .. name .. "' that isn't ours: left alone")
				return
			end
		end
	end

	local flag = Instance.new("BoolValue")
	flag.Name = name
	flag.Value = CONFIG.skin.owned
	flag:SetAttribute(SKIN_TAG, true)
	flag.Parent = folder
	print("[Skin] added BoolValue '" .. name .. "' (" .. tostring(flag.Value) .. ") to " .. folder:GetFullName())
end

-- The skin picker's A/D handler skips every skin that DatastoreScript:Get(LocalPlayer, skinName) doesn't return
-- as truthy, and Get reads the module's plrData table, not the BoolValues. So the ownership goes in there too.
local function setOwnedInModule()
	local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local mod = rs:WaitForChild("Modules", 10) and rs.Modules:WaitForChild("DatastoreScript", 10)
	if not mod then warn("[Skin] DatastoreScript not found") return end
	local DS = require(mod)
	local uid = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.UserId
	local deadline = os.clock() + 30
	while not (DS.plrData and DS.plrData[uid]) and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait(0.25) end
	if not (DS.plrData and DS.plrData[uid]) then warn("[Skin] plrData not loaded, ownership not set") return end
	DS.plrData[uid][CONFIG.skin.name] = CONFIG.skin.owned and true or nil
	print("[Skin] set " .. CONFIG.skin.name .. " = " .. tostring(CONFIG.skin.owned) .. " in DatastoreScript.plrData")
end

task.spawn(function()
	local okS, errS = pcall(prepareOriginal)
	if not okS then warn("[Skin] Original (MVPSound / Fanfare) failed: " .. tostring(errS)) end
	-- the assets first, then the skin, then the BoolValue, so everything it points to already exists
	local okA, errA = pcall(addSkinAssets)
	if not okA then warn("[Skin] SkinAssets copy failed: " .. tostring(errA)) end
	local ok, err = pcall(addSkin)
	if not ok then warn("[Skin] failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
	local okF, errF = pcall(addSkinFlag)
	if not okF then warn("[Skin] BoolValue failed: " .. tostring(errF)) end
	local okM, errM = pcall(setOwnedInModule)
	if not okM then warn("[Skin] plrData ownership failed: " .. tostring(errM)) end
end)

-- ===== Viewport copy: PlayerGui.List.Viewport1.WorldModel.Original =====
local viewportDone = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function isViewportOriginal(inst)
	local worldModel = inst.Parent
	return inst.Name == "Original" and inst:IsA("Model")
		and worldModel ~= nil and worldModel.Name == "WorldModel"
		and worldModel.Parent ~= nil and worldModel.Parent.Name == "Viewport1"
end

local function trySetupViewport(vm)
	if not isCurrentRun() or viewportDone[vm] or not isViewportOriginal(vm) then return end
	if not vm:FindFirstChild(MARKER) then return end -- not the Biograft model: left alone
	if not isValencina() then return end -- another skin is equipped
	viewportDone[vm] = true
	print("[Dress] Viewport copy has " .. MARKER .. ": dressing it")
	watchModel(vm, true, "Viewport")
end

local function considerViewport(inst)
	if inst.Name ~= "Original" then return end
	trySetupViewport(inst)
	inst.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child.Name == MARKER then trySetupViewport(inst) end
	end)
	inst.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		trySetupViewport(inst)
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	if not isCurrentRun() then return end
	for _, d in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
		considerViewport(d)
		followViewportClone(d)
	end
	keep(playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
		considerViewport(d)
		-- a clone's meshes arrive with it, but its parent is set a moment later: check again next frame
		if d:IsA("MeshPart") then task.defer(followViewportClone, d) end
	end))
end)
end

-- ===== slash effects (animation-triggered, rebuilt from captured effect data) =====
do
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer


-- ===== helpers to rebuild instances from captured data =====
local function NR(v) if type(v) == "table" then return NumberRange.new(v[1], v[2] or v[1]) end return NumberRange.new(v) end
local function NS(v)
	if type(v) == "number" then return NumberSequence.new(v) end
	local k = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(v) do k[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(p[1], p[2], p[3] or 0) end
	return NumberSequence.new(k)
end
local function CS(v)
	if type(v[1]) == "number" then return ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(v[1], v[2], v[3])) end
	local k = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(v) do k[i] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(p[1], Color3.fromRGB(p[2], p[3], p[4])) end
	return ColorSequence.new(k)
end
local function D(base)
	return function(o)
		local t = {}
		for k, v in pairs(base) do t[k] = v end
		for k, v in pairs(o or {}) do t[k] = v end
		return t
	end
end

local function att(name, pos, kids, rot) return { k = "att", name = name, pos = pos, rot = rot, kids = kids or {} } end
local function pe(name, o) return { k = "pe", name = name, o = o } end
local function light(o) return { k = "light", o = o } end

-- ===== flipbook layout per texture =====
-- Every flipbook particle must use the layout that matches its sprite sheet. A wrong layout shows one small
-- cell of the sheet stretched over the whole particle, which looks pixelated. Valid values:
-- "None", "Grid2x2", "Grid4x4", "Grid8x8". An emitter's own `flip = ...` still wins over this table.
-- Change a value here (or live: BiocinaFlip.set("91945477891076", "Grid8x8")) until a single frame looks whole.
local FLIPENV = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
local BiocinaFlip = {} -- rebuilt on every run so edits to the values below always apply
FLIPENV.BiocinaFlip = BiocinaFlip
BiocinaFlip.default = "Grid4x4"
BiocinaFlip.tremor = "Grid4x4" -- texture 14762708319 (Tremor Burst)
-- Optional: use a full-resolution local copy of a sprite sheet instead of the uploaded asset. Put the PNG in your
-- executor workspace folder and map the texture id to its file name, e.g. localTex["91945477891076"] = "slash1.png"
BiocinaFlip.localTex = {
	["91945477891076"]  = "91945477891076.png",
	["116842793970817"] = "116842793970817.png",
	["129622989588953"] = "129622989588953.png",
}
BiocinaFlip.tex = {
	["91945477891076"]  = "Grid4x4", -- Layered Dark Slash
	["116842793970817"] = "Grid4x4", -- Layered Dark Slash
	["129622989588953"] = "Grid4x4", -- Layered Dark Slash (Top)
	["13350500478"]     = "Grid4x4",
	["16172858603"]     = "Grid4x4", -- smoke
	["17085222506"]     = "Grid4x4", -- swirl crescent
	["93720487300608"]  = "Grid4x4",
}
-- Live test overrides applied to every "Layered Dark Slash" emitter, e.g.
-- BiocinaFlip.override.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera
-- BiocinaFlip.override.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6)
-- BiocinaFlip.override.LightEmission = 0   -- clear one with = nil
BiocinaFlip.override = {}

-- ===== texture sharpness (fixes pixelated slash textures on some executors) =====
-- The emitters are identical on every executor (same ids, Grid4x4, sizes), so the blur comes from the client
-- drawing the sprite sheets at a reduced mip/resolution. This block (1) asks the client for full texture quality,
-- (2) raises the render quality level for this session, and (3) preloads every sprite sheet so the full-resolution
-- image is already loaded when a slash is emitted. Every step is wrapped in pcall, so an executor that lacks
-- setfflag / settings() just skips that step. Set BiocinaFlip.sharp = false to disable all of it.
BiocinaFlip.sharp = true
BiocinaFlip.preloadIds = {
	"91945477891076", "116842793970817", "129622989588953", "78267222277920", "13350500478", "17085222506",
	"16172858603", "137776448998566", "17062451848", "93720487300608", "124470824659004", "84551489181706",
	"129975854146715", "115890666692927", "17317111249", "14762708319",
}
if BiocinaFlip.sharp then
	pcall(function()
		if setfflag then
			setfflag("DFFlagTextureQualityOverrideEnabled", "True")
			setfflag("DFIntTextureQualityOverride", "3") -- 3 = highest
		end
	end)
	pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level21 end)
	task.spawn(function()
		local list = {}
		for _, id in ipairs(BiocinaFlip.preloadIds) do list[#list + 1] = "rbxassetid://" .. id end
		pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(list) end)
	end)
end

function BiocinaFlip.set(tex, layout)
	if tex == "tremor" then BiocinaFlip.tremor = layout else BiocinaFlip.tex[tostring(tex)] = layout end
end
function BiocinaFlip.resolve(name)
	local ok, layout = pcall(function() return Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout[name] end)
	if ok and layout then return layout end
	warn("Biocina: bad flipbook layout '" .. tostring(name) .. "', using Grid4x4")
	return Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4
end

-- Preview: BiocinaFlip.preview("91945477891076") plays that texture once per layout on your character,
-- one every 1.5s, printing the layout name each time. Note which one shows a whole, sharp slash, then
-- put it in the table above. (Optional 2nd arg: size in studs, default 8.857.)
function BiocinaFlip.preview(tex, size)
	local char = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then warn("Biocina preview: no HumanoidRootPart") return end
	task.spawn(function()
		for _, name in ipairs({ "None", "Grid2x2", "Grid4x4", "Grid8x8" }) do
			local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
			a.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -6)
			a.Parent = hrp
			local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			p.Enabled = false
			p.Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(tex)
			p.FlipbookLayout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout[name]
			p.FlipbookMode = Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
			p.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1)
			p.Speed = NumberRange.new(0)
			p.Size = NumberSequence.new(size or 8.857)
			p.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera
			p.LockedToPart = true
			p.LightEmission = 0.25
			p.Brightness = 2
			p.Parent = a
			print("Biocina preview " .. tostring(tex) .. " -> " .. name)
			p:Emit(1)
			game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(a, 2)
			task.wait(1.5)
		end
	end)
end

local function build(n, parent)
	if n.k == "att" then
		local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a.Name = n.name
		a.Position = Vector3.new(unpack(n.pos))
		if n.rot then a.Orientation = Vector3.new(unpack(n.rot)) end
		a.Parent = parent
		for _, c in ipairs(n.kids) do build(c, a) end
	elseif n.k == "pe" then
		local o = n.o
		local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		p.Name = n.name
		p.Enabled = false
		p.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		if o.accelV then p.Acceleration = Vector3.new(unpack(o.accelV)) end
		p.Brightness = o.bright or 1
		p.Color = CS(o.col)
		p.Drag = o.drag or 0
		p.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId[o.dir or "Front"]
		p.FlipbookLayout = BiocinaFlip.resolve(o.flip or BiocinaFlip.tex[tostring(o.tex)] or BiocinaFlip.default)
		p.FlipbookMode = Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode[o.flipMode or "OneShot"]
		p.FlipbookFramerate = NR(o.fps or 1)
		p.FlipbookStartRandom = o.flipRand or false
		p.Lifetime = NR(o.life)
		p.LightEmission = o.lightEm or 0
		p.LightInfluence = o.lightInf or 0
		p.LockedToPart = o.locked ~= false
		p.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation[o.orient or "VelocityPerpendicular"]
		p.Rate = o.rate or 5
		p.RotSpeed = NR(o.rotSpeed or 0)
		p.Rotation = NR(o.rot or 0)
		p.Size = NS(o.size)
		p.Speed = NR(o.speed)
		local sp = o.spread or { 0, 0 }
		p.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(sp[1], sp[2])
		p.Squash = NS(o.sq or 0)
		p.Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. o.tex
		local lf = BiocinaFlip.localTex[tostring(o.tex)]
		if lf then
			local okT, idT = pcall(getcustomasset, lf)
			if okT and idT then p.Texture = idT else warn("Biocina: couldn't load " .. lf) end
		end
		p.Transparency = NS(o.tr or 0)
		p.ZOffset = o.zoff or 0
		if n.name == "Layered Dark Slash" then
			for prop, val in pairs(BiocinaFlip.override) do p[prop] = val end
		end
		p:SetAttribute("EmitCount", o.emit or 1)
		if o.delay then p:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", o.delay) end
		p.Parent = parent
	elseif n.k == "light" then
		local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
		l.Brightness = n.o.bright
		l.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 209, 135)
		l.Range = n.o.range
		l.Shadows = true
		l.Enabled = true
		l:SetAttribute("Duration", 0.35)
		l.Parent = parent
	end
end

end

-- No captures exist for Combo1 / Combo2, so they are based on the captured Combo3 slash.
-- To use real data later, replace these with EFFECTS["Combo1"] = { ... } etc.
local function deepCopy(t)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then return t end
	local c = {}
	for k, v in pairs(t) do c[k] = deepCopy(v) end
	return c
end

-- Combo1: the Combo3 slash as captured
EFFECTS["Combo1"] = EFFECTS["Combo3"]

-- Combo2: Combo3's slash, tilted into a diagonal.
-- It starts at the character exactly like Combo3 and keeps Combo3's captured facing, so it
-- still swings forward. The slash plane is rolled around the character's forward axis, which
-- raises one side so the cut reads as a diagonal, and then moved to the character's right side.
--   DIAG_TILT   - the roll in degrees. Negative = the cut rises (what this is set to now).
--                 If it falls instead, use the positive number. Bigger = steeper.
--   DIAG_SIDE_X - sideways position of the slash. Positive = right side of the character,
--                 negative = left. Raise it to push the slash further right.
--   DIAG_SPIN   - turns the slash around the vertical axis, inside its own plane, BEFORE the
--                 tilt is applied. The captured slash is a flat arc around the character
--                 (it lies roughly horizontal), so moving it with the X offset barely changes
--                 which side the arc sits on. Spinning it 180 swaps the left half for the
--                 right half. If it lands on the wrong spot, try 90, -90 or 0.
-- Slash settings (all degrees)
--   tilt = roll around the character's forward axis: 0 = flat/horizontal, +-40 = diagonal, +-90 = vertical
--   spin = turns the arc around the vertical axis, which decides which side of the character it sits on
local DIAG_TILT   = -40
local DIAG_SPIN   = -130
local DIAG_SIDE_X = 0.267

local HORIZ_TILT  = 0
local HORIZ_SPIN  = -90  -- -90 = arc in front of the character. Try 90 for behind, or +-130 to match the diagonals
local VERT_TILT   = 90   -- 90 or -90 flips whether the cut reads as top-to-bottom or bottom-to-top
local VERT_SPIN   = -90  -- arc in front of the character

-- Builds one slash from the captured Combo3 slash.
-- mirror = true builds the left/right flipped version (used for the other half of the X).
local function makeSlash(tilt, spin, side, mirror)
	local eff = deepCopy(EFFECTS["Combo3"])
	local blade = eff[1]
	local rx, ry, rz = math.rad(blade.rot[1]), math.rad(blade.rot[2]), math.rad(blade.rot[3])
	if mirror then
		ry, rz = -ry, -rz
		tilt, spin, side = -tilt, -spin, -side
	end
	local base = CFrame.fromOrientation(rx, ry, rz)
	-- spin the arc around the vertical axis first, then roll the whole plane
	local spun = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(spin), 0) * base
	local ox, oy, oz = (CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(tilt)) * spun):ToOrientation()
	blade.rot = { math.deg(ox), math.deg(oy), math.deg(oz) }
	blade.pos = { side, blade.pos[2], blade.pos[3] }
	return eff
end

EFFECTS["Combo2"]  = makeSlash(DIAG_TILT, DIAG_SPIN, DIAG_SIDE_X, false)
-- Combo2B: the mirrored diagonal. Played together with Combo2 it makes an X.
EFFECTS["Combo2B"] = makeSlash(DIAG_TILT, DIAG_SPIN, DIAG_SIDE_X, true)
-- SlashH: horizontal slash, SlashV: vertical slash
EFFECTS["SlashH"]  = makeSlash(HORIZ_TILT, HORIZ_SPIN, 0, false)
EFFECTS["SlashV"]  = makeSlash(VERT_TILT, VERT_SPIN, 0, false)
