local EXTRA_LIFETIME = 2 -- seconds after dur before the effects are removed, so particles can finish

-- ===== effect playback =====
local function activate(inst)
	local list = inst:GetDescendants()
	table.insert(list, inst)
	for _, d in ipairs(list) do
		if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local count = d:GetAttribute("EmitCount")
			local delay = d:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") or 0
			task.delay(delay, function()
				if not d.Parent then return end
				if count then d:Emit(count) else d.Enabled = true end
			end)
		elseif d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("PointLight") or d:IsA("SpotLight") then
			d.Enabled = true
			local dur = d:GetAttribute("Duration")
			if dur then
				task.delay(dur, function() if d.Parent then d.Enabled = false end end)
			end
		elseif d:IsA("Sound") then
			d:Play()
		end
	end
end

local lastPlayed = {}
local EFFECT_COOLDOWN = 0.25 -- the same effect can't be built twice within this many seconds

local function playEffect(root, name, dur)
	local def = EFFECTS[name]
	if not def then
		warn("no captured data for effect: " .. name)
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastPlayed[name] and now - lastPlayed[name] < EFFECT_COOLDOWN then return end
	lastPlayed[name] = now
	local before = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do before[c] = true end

	for _, node in ipairs(def) do build(node, root) end

	local made = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
		if not before[c] then
			table.insert(made, c)
			activate(c)
		end
	end

	task.delay(dur + EXTRA_LIFETIME, function()
		for _, c in ipairs(made) do
			if c.Parent then c:Destroy() end
		end
	end)
end

-- ===== Shin effect =====
-- Animation ids that turn Shin on. It is created the first time one of them plays and then stays
-- on the character (it is only removed if the character itself is removed).
local SHIN_ANIMS = {
	["10492171572"] = true,
}

local function createShin(char)
	if char:FindFirstChild("Shin") then return end -- already on, keep it

	local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
		or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
		or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not torso or not torso:IsA("BasePart") then
		warn("Shin: couldn't find a torso")
		return
	end

	local shin = Instance.new("Part")
	shin.Name = "Shin"
	shin.Size = Vector3.new(4, 1.701, 4)
	shin.Transparency = 1
	shin.CanCollide = false
	shin.CanTouch = false
	shin.CanQuery = false
	shin.Massless = true
	shin.Anchored = false
	shin.CFrame = torso.CFrame
	shin.Parent = char

	local shinWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	shinWeld.Part0 = torso
	shinWeld.Part1 = shin
	shinWeld.Parent = shin

	local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a0.Name = "A0"
	a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, -6, 0)
	a0.Parent = shin

	local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a1.Name = "A1"
	a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
	a1.Parent = shin

	local beamColor = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1, 0.717647, 0.152941)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(1, 0.717647, 0.152941)),
	})

	local transparencyB1 = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.468244, 0.865591),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.630137, 0.951613),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})

	local transparencyB2 = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.135741, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.240349, 0.349462),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.37609, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.524284, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6401, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.688667, 0.532258),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.732254, 0.822581),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.836862, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})

	local transparencyB3 = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.514321, 0.833333),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})

	local beamSettings = {
		b1 = {
			Texture = "rbxassetid://2382169232",
			Width0 = 4.5, Width1 = 5.5, Brightness = 0.5,
			TextureLength = 0.4, TextureSpeed = 0.125,
			Transparency = transparencyB1,
		},
		b2 = {
			Texture = "rbxassetid://123339024056687",
			Width0 = 7, Width1 = 7, Brightness = 0.4,
			TextureLength = 0.2, TextureSpeed = 0.1,
			Transparency = transparencyB2,
		},
		b3 = {
			Texture = "rbxassetid://82177808961676",
			Width0 = 6, Width1 = 6, Brightness = 0.3,
			TextureLength = 0.5, TextureSpeed = 0.2,
			Transparency = transparencyB3,
		},
		b5 = {
			Texture = "rbxassetid://76072153222639",
			Width0 = 6, Width1 = 6, Brightness = 1,
			TextureLength = 0.375, TextureSpeed = 0.12,
			Transparency = transparencyB2, -- same curve the original used for b5
		},
	}

	for beamName, s in pairs(beamSettings) do
		local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
		beam.Name = beamName
		beam.Attachment0 = a0
		beam.Attachment1 = a1
		beam.FaceCamera = true
		beam.ZOffset = -1
		beam.LightInfluence = 0
		beam.LightEmission = 1
		beam.Segments = 10
		beam.CurveSize0 = 0
		beam.CurveSize1 = 0
		beam.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch
		beam.Enabled = true
		beam.Color = beamColor
		beam.Texture = s.Texture
		beam.Width0 = s.Width0
		beam.Width1 = s.Width1
		beam.Brightness = s.Brightness
		beam.TextureLength = s.TextureLength
		beam.TextureSpeed = s.TextureSpeed
		beam.Transparency = s.Transparency
		beam.Parent = shin
	end
end

-- ===== animation watching =====
-- Polls playing tracks instead of relying on AnimationPlayed, so animations started
-- by the game (client or server) are both caught.
local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
if env.__slashConn then env.__slashConn:Disconnect() end
if env.__slashChar then env.__slashChar:Disconnect() end

-- ===== blade trail (real Trail instance on the blade mesh, on only while slashing) =====
local TRAIL_MESH = "AccessoryTheThumbNursefathersCleavingBladeV2Waist_88221975027040"
local TRAIL_HEIGHT = 2   -- how tall the trail ribbon is, in studs (the blade mesh is 5.498 long; lower = thinner)
local TRAIL_CENTER = 0   -- slide the ribbon along the blade (+Z / -Z) if it should sit nearer the tip or the handle
local BLADE_HALF = TRAIL_HEIGHT / 2
local trailToken = 0

local function getBladeTrail(char)
	local mesh = char:FindFirstChild(TRAIL_MESH, true)
	if not mesh then return nil end
	local t = mesh:FindFirstChild("SlashTrail")
	if t and t.Attachment0 and t.Attachment1 then
		t.Attachment0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, TRAIL_CENTER - BLADE_HALF)
		t.Attachment1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, TRAIL_CENTER + BLADE_HALF)
		return t
	end
	if t then t:Destroy() end
	local a0 = mesh:FindFirstChild("TrailA0") or Instance.new("Attachment")
	a0.Name = "TrailA0"
	a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, TRAIL_CENTER - BLADE_HALF)
	a0.Parent = mesh
	local a1 = mesh:FindFirstChild("TrailA1") or Instance.new("Attachment")
	a1.Name = "TrailA1"
	a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, TRAIL_CENTER + BLADE_HALF)
	a1.Parent = mesh
	t = Instance.new("Trail")
	t.Name = "SlashTrail"
	t.Attachment0 = a0
	t.Attachment1 = a1
	t.Enabled = false
	t.Lifetime = 0.35
	t.MinLength = 0.05
	t.FaceCamera = true
	t.LightEmission = 0.7
	t.LightInfluence = 0
	t.Brightness = 2
	t.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 87)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(239, 128, 113)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(172, 38, 45)),
	})
	t.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	t.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.2),
	})
	t.Parent = mesh
	return t
end

-- turn the trail on from `start` for `len` seconds
local function playBladeTrail(char, start, len)
	task.delay(start, function()
		local t = getBladeTrail(char)
		if not t then return end
		trailToken += 1
		local mine = trailToken
		t.Enabled = true
		task.delay(len, function()
			if trailToken == mine and t.Parent then t.Enabled = false end
		end)
	end)
end

local seen = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

-- Some games play the same animation on two tracks (client + server copy), which fired
-- every effect twice. The same animation id can't retrigger within this many seconds.
local RETRIGGER_COOLDOWN = 0.3
local lastFired = {}

local function watch(char)
	if env.__slashConn then env.__slashConn:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(seen)

	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	if not hum or not root then return end
	local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum

	env.__slashConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not char.Parent or not isValencina() then return end
		for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
			if not seen[track] then
				seen[track] = true
				local id = string.match(track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId or "", "%d+")
				if id and SHIN_ANIMS[id] then
					local okShin, errShin = pcall(createShin, char)
					if not okShin then warn("Shin: " .. tostring(errShin)) end
				end
				local effects = id and SLASHES[id]
				local now = os.clock()
				if effects and lastFired[id] and now - lastFired[id] < RETRIGGER_COOLDOWN then
					effects = nil -- duplicate track of the same animation
				end
				if effects then
					lastFired[id] = now
					local first, last = math.huge, 0
					for _, e in ipairs(effects) do
						first = math.min(first, e.start)
						last = math.max(last, e.start)
					end
					playBladeTrail(char, math.max(first - 0.15, 0), (last - first) + 0.5)
					for _, e in ipairs(effects) do
						task.delay(e.start, function()
							if root.Parent then playEffect(root, e.name, e.dur) end
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then task.spawn(watch, LocalPlayer.Character) end
env.__slashChar = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.spawn(watch, c) end)
end

-- ===== Valencina skill icons (HUD) =====
-- Needs valskill1.png .. valskill4.png in your executor's workspace folder (getcustomasset).
-- Runs in its own thread so the WaitForChild calls below can't hold up the rest of the script.
task.spawn(function()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local frame = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    :WaitForChild("Abilities"):WaitForChild("Frame")
local biograft = RS.ClassFolders.Biograft

-- HUD button -> Biograft decal + your image + box size + key text color
local skills = {
    { slot = "rmb", decal = "Secondary", file = "valskill1.png", target = 66, buttonSize = 70, textColor = Color3.fromHex("#416fd9") },
    { slot = "q",   decal = "Q",         file = "valskill2.png", target = 66, buttonSize = 70, textColor = Color3.fromHex("#fce813") },
    { slot = "e",   decal = "E",         file = "valskill3.png", target = 66, buttonSize = 70, textColor = Color3.fromHex("#ff9200") },
    { slot = "f",   decal = "F",         file = "valskill4.png", target = 83, buttonSize = 88, textColor = Color3.fromHex("#ff0902") },
}

-- settings
local BASE_THICKNESS = 3
local STROKE_COLOR = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

-- stop the previous run's cooldown loop if you run this twice
local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
if env.__valskillConn then env.__valskillConn:Disconnect() end

local mirrored = {}

-- a second execution disconnects the previous run's listeners (older runs weren't gated on the skin)
if env.__valskillConns then
    for _, c in ipairs(env.__valskillConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
end
local conns = {}
env.__valskillConns = conns
env.__valskillOrig = env.__valskillOrig or {} -- real key text colors, from before this script touched them
local updaters = {}

for _, s in ipairs(skills) do
    local btn = frame:WaitForChild(s.slot)
    local ability = btn:WaitForChild("Ability")
    local label = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
    local decal = biograft:FindFirstChild(s.decal)

    -- Biograft's real icon texture (decals are no longer blanked)
    local bioTexture = ""
    if decal and (decal:IsA("Decal") or decal:IsA("Texture")) then
        bioTexture = decal.Texture
    end
    if bioTexture == "" then
        warn(s.slot .. ": Biograft." .. s.decal .. " texture is empty. Rejoin first, then run again.")
    end

    if label and env.__valskillOrig[s.slot] == nil then env.__valskillOrig[s.slot] = label.TextColor3 end
    local originalTextColor = env.__valskillOrig[s.slot]
    local thickness = math.floor(BASE_THICKNESS * s.buttonSize / 70 + 0.5)

    -- your image with a square outline, under Glow / Ability / X / text
    local old = btn:FindFirstChild("CustomSkill")
    if old then
        old:Destroy()
        -- put back what an earlier run forced on this button
        btn.ImageTransparency = 0
        ability.ImageTransparency = 0
        if label and originalTextColor then label.TextColor3 = originalTextColor end
    end

    local scale = s.target / s.buttonSize

    local overlay = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    overlay.Name = "CustomSkill"
    overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    overlay.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    overlay.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    overlay.Size = UDim2.new(scale, -thickness * 2, scale, -thickness * 2)
    overlay.Image = getcustomasset(s.file)
    overlay.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
    overlay.ZIndex = 0
    overlay.Visible = false
    overlay.Parent = btn

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Thickness = thickness
    stroke.Color = STROKE_COLOR
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    stroke.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter
    stroke.Parent = overlay

    -- cooldown bar: mirror any UIGradient from the button onto your image
    local count = 0
    for _, g in ipairs(btn:GetChildren()) do
        if g:IsA("UIGradient") then
            local copy = g:Clone()
            copy.Parent = overlay
            table.insert(mirrored, { src = g, dst = copy })
            count += 1
        end
    end

    -- on/off switch: active only while the HUD shows Biograft's icon
    local active = false

    local function enforce()
        if not active then return end
        if btn.ImageTransparency ~= 1 then btn.ImageTransparency = 1 end
        if ability.ImageTransparency ~= 1 then ability.ImageTransparency = 1 end
        if label and s.textColor and label.TextColor3 ~= s.textColor then
            label.TextColor3 = s.textColor
        end
    end

    local function update()
        local shouldBeActive = bioTexture ~= "" and ability.Image == bioTexture and isValencina()
        if shouldBeActive == active then return end
        active = shouldBeActive

        overlay.Visible = active
        if active then
            enforce()
        else
            -- back to normal
            btn.ImageTransparency = 0
            ability.ImageTransparency = 0
            if label and originalTextColor then
                label.TextColor3 = originalTextColor
            end
        end
    end

    table.insert(updaters, update)
    table.insert(conns, ability:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"):Connect(update))
    table.insert(conns, btn:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageTransparency"):Connect(enforce))
    table.insert(conns, ability:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageTransparency"):Connect(enforce))
    if label then table.insert(conns, label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3"):Connect(enforce)) end

    update()
    print(s.slot, "mirrored", count, "gradient(s), active:", active)
end

-- the icons follow the equipped skin: on when you pick Valencina, back to the game's own when you don't
onSkinChange(function()
    for _, u in ipairs(updaters) do u() end
end)

env.__valskillConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    for _, p in ipairs(mirrored) do
        local src, dst = p.src, p.dst
        dst.Enabled = src.Enabled
        dst.Color = src.Color
        dst.Transparency = src.Transparency
        dst.Offset = src.Offset
        dst.Rotation = src.Rotation
    end
end)
end)

-- ===== Tremor Burst: plays on the 4th primary (M1) swing if its slash touches someone =====
-- Needs burst.ogg in your executor's workspace folder (getcustomasset).
-- Runs in its own scope so an error here can't affect anything above.
do
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- settings
local CYCLE_SWINGS      = 4          -- the burst fires on this swing of each M1 cycle
local CYCLE_TIMEOUT     = 3          -- seconds without an M1 swing before the cycle restarts
local SLASH_RANGE       = 12         -- studs around you counted as "touched by the slash"
local RETRIGGER_COOLDOWN = 0.3       -- same animation can't count twice within this (client + server track copies)
local EFFECT_DURATION   = 1.5        -- from the capture (EffectDuration)
local SOUND_FILE        = "burst.ogg"
local SOUND_VOLUME      = 2

-- primary attack animation id -> seconds after it starts when its slash appears
local PRIMARY_ANIMS = {
	["10423747284"] = 0.27,  -- Combo1
	["10423750019"] = 0.215, -- Combo2
	["10423753479"] = 0.215, -- Combo3
	["10423756260"] = 0.25,  -- M1 (slash timing is a guess; adjust if the burst feels early/late)
}

-- ===== sound =====
local soundId
local function getSoundId()
	if soundId then return soundId end
	local ok, res = pcall(getcustomasset, SOUND_FILE)
	if ok and res then
		soundId = res
	else
		warn("Tremor Burst: couldn't load " .. SOUND_FILE .. " (" .. tostring(res) .. ")")
	end
	return soundId
end

local function playBurstSound()
	local id = getSoundId()
	if not id then return end
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.Name = "TremorBurstSound"
	s.SoundId = id
	s.Volume = SOUND_VOLUME
	s.Parent = SoundService
	s:Play()
	s.Ended:Once(function() s:Destroy() end)
	Debris:AddItem(s, 15)
end

-- ===== effect (rebuilt from the TremorBurst capture, EffectType = HRP) =====
local function NS2(a, b)
	return NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, b) })
end

local EMITTERS = {
	{ life = 0.2, size0 = 4 },
	{ life = 0.1, size0 = 0 },
	{ life = 0.5, size0 = 4 },
}

local function playTremor(victim)
	local hrp = victim and victim:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end

	local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a.Name = "PartHit"
	a.Parent = hrp

	for _, d in ipairs(EMITTERS) do
		local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		p.Name = "Emit"
		p.Enabled = false
		p.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		p.Brightness = 1.4
		p.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 0))
		p.Drag = 15
		p.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Back
		local bf = (getgenv and getgenv() or _G).BiocinaFlip
		p.FlipbookLayout = bf and bf.resolve(bf.tremor) or Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4
		p.FlipbookMode = Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
		p.FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(1, 1)
		p.FlipbookStartRandom = false
		p.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(d.life, d.life)
		p.LightEmission = -1.25
		p.LightInfluence = 0
		p.LockedToPart = true
		p.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera
		p.Rate = 20
		p.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
		p.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
		p.Size = NS2(d.size0, 10)
		p.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01, 0.01)
		p.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(356, 356)
		p.Squash = NumberSequence.new(0)
		p.Texture = "rbxassetid://14762708319"
		p.TimeScale = 0.5
		p.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
		p.ZOffset = 2
		p:SetAttribute("EmitCount", 1)
		p.Parent = a
		p:Emit(1)
	end

	Debris:AddItem(a, EFFECT_DURATION + 0.5)
end

-- ===== who is the slash touching? =====
local function findTouched(char, root)
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }

	local found, list = {}, {}
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(root.Position, SLASH_RANGE, params)) do
		local m = part
		while m and m ~= workspace do
			if m:IsA("Model") and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then break end
			m = m.Parent
		end
		if m and m ~= workspace and not found[m] and m ~= char then
			local hum = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local other = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m)
			local teammate = other and LocalPlayer.Team ~= nil and other.Team == LocalPlayer.Team
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 and m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and not teammate then
				found[m] = true
				table.insert(list, m)
			end
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- ===== primary swing counting =====
local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
if env.__tremorAnimConn then env.__tremorAnimConn:Disconnect() end
if env.__tremorChar then env.__tremorChar:Disconnect() end
if env.__tremorHitConn then env.__tremorHitConn:Disconnect() env.__tremorHitConn = nil end -- old version's hit listener

local cycle, lastSwing = 0, -math.huge
local lastFired = {}
local seen = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function onPrimary(char, root, delay)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastSwing > CYCLE_TIMEOUT then cycle = 0 end
	lastSwing = now
	cycle += 1
	if cycle < CYCLE_SWINGS then return end
	cycle = 0 -- cycle restarts whether or not the burst lands

	task.delay(delay, function()
		if not root.Parent then return end
		local victims = findTouched(char, root)
		if #victims == 0 then return end
		playBurstSound()
		for _, v in ipairs(victims) do
			playTremor(v)
		end
	end)
end

local function watch(char)
	if env.__tremorAnimConn then env.__tremorAnimConn:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(seen)
	cycle, lastSwing = 0, -math.huge
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	if not hum or not root then return end
	local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum
	env.__tremorAnimConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not char.Parent or not isValencina() then return end
		for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
			if not seen[track] then
				seen[track] = true
				local id = string.match(track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId or "", "%d+")
				local delay = id and PRIMARY_ANIMS[id]
				if delay then
					local now = os.clock()
					if not (lastFired[id] and now - lastFired[id] < RETRIGGER_COOLDOWN) then
						lastFired[id] = now
						onPrimary(char, root, delay)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then task.spawn(watch, LocalPlayer.Character) end
env.__tremorChar = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.spawn(watch, c) end)
end

-- ===== Sound replacements (swaps game sounds for your custom files) =====
-- Needs these files in your executor's workspace folder. Runs in its own scope.
do
	local files = {
		["rbxassetid://4374878364"]  = "valm1.wav",
		["rbxassetid://5855426214"]  = "valqfire.wav",
		["rbxassetid://1043234674"]  = "valqdash.wav",
		["rbxassetid://605568980"]   = "valqhit.wav",
		["rbxassetid://3289150551"]  = "valqwarn.ogg",
		["rbxassetid://912078533"]   = "valqtarget.ogg",
		["rbxassetid://1218913424"]  = "valedash.wav",
		["rbxassetid://5184038803"]  = "valf.ogg",
		["rbxassetid://144699494"]   = "valfexplosion.wav",
	}

	local replacements = {}
	for id, file in pairs(files) do
		local ok, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, file)
		if ok and asset then
			replacements[id] = asset
		else
			warn("Sound replace: couldn't load " .. file)
		end
	end

	-- sounds that get silenced (a SoundId can't be a real nil, so they are set to an empty string)
	local MUTED = {
		["rbxassetid://13156744147"] = true, -- set to nil (silent)
	}

	-- Only active while Valencina Biograft is equipped. The original SoundId of every sound that gets touched is
	-- remembered (in env, so a second execution still knows them) and put back when you switch to another skin.
	local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
	env.__valSoundOriginals = env.__valSoundOriginals or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local originals = env.__valSoundOriginals
	local mutedHooked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	local function apply(sound)
		if not sound:IsA("Sound") then return end
		local orig = originals[sound]
		if orig ~= nil then
			local cur = sound.SoundId
			if cur ~= orig and cur ~= replacements[orig] and cur ~= "" then
				originals[sound] = nil -- the game gave this Sound a different id since: not ours anymore
				return apply(sound)
			end
		else
			local id = sound.SoundId
			if not (MUTED[id] or replacements[id]) then return end
			if not isValencina() then return end -- nothing to change, so nothing to remember
			originals[sound] = id
			orig = id
		end

		local want = orig
		if isValencina() then
			want = MUTED[orig] and "" or (replacements[orig] or orig)
		end
		if sound.SoundId ~= want then
			sound.SoundId = want
			if want == "" then sound:Stop() end
		end

		-- if the game puts the muted id back on this same Sound later, silence it again (only while ours)
		if MUTED[orig] and not mutedHooked[sound] then
			mutedHooked[sound] = true
			sound:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SoundId"):Connect(function()
				if isValencina() and MUTED[sound.SoundId] then
					sound.SoundId = ""
					sound:Stop()
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	local function syncAll(now)
		if now then
			for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do apply(d) end
		else
			local list = {}
			for sound in pairs(originals) do list[#list + 1] = sound end
			for _, sound in ipairs(list) do apply(sound) end
		end
	end

	syncAll(isValencina()) -- also puts back sounds an earlier execution replaced, if you aren't Valencina now
	onSkinChange(syncAll)

	if env.__soundReplaceConn then env.__soundReplaceConn:Disconnect() end
	env.__soundReplaceConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
		task.wait()
		apply(descendant)
	end)
end

-- ===== Forced Pitch / PlaybackSpeed = 1 (only these four sounds) =====
-- ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Biograft.SkinAssets.Original: Shoot, UltSound2, Dash2, Dash
-- The server builds the character as Original, so these are the sounds the game actually plays. They are only
-- forced while Valencina Biograft is equipped; their real values are saved first and put back otherwise.
do
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local NAMES = { "Shoot", "UltSound2", "Dash2", "Dash" }
	local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
	env.__valPitchSaved = env.__valPitchSaved or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local saved = env.__valPitchSaved -- sound -> { speed = n, octaves = { [effect] = n } } while it is forced
	local hooked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local sounds = {}

	local function forceOne(sound)
		if not isValencina() then return end
		local rec = saved[sound]
		if not rec then
			rec = { speed = sound.PlaybackSpeed, octaves = {} }
			saved[sound] = rec
		end
		if sound.PlaybackSpeed ~= 1 then sound.PlaybackSpeed = 1 end
		pcall(function() sound.Pitch = 1 end) -- legacy Pitch property, if it still exists
		for _, c in ipairs(sound:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("PitchShiftSoundEffect") then
				if rec.octaves[c] == nil then rec.octaves[c] = c.Octave end
				if c.Octave ~= 1 then c.Octave = 1 end
			end
		end
	end

	local function restoreOne(sound)
		local rec = saved[sound]
		if not rec then return end
		saved[sound] = nil
		sound.PlaybackSpeed = rec.speed
		for c, octave in pairs(rec.octaves) do
			if c.Parent then c.Octave = octave end
		end
	end

	local function lock(sound)
		table.insert(sounds, sound)
		forceOne(sound)
		if hooked[sound] then return end
		hooked[sound] = true
		sound:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PlaybackSpeed"):Connect(function() forceOne(sound) end)
		pcall(function()
			sound:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Pitch"):Connect(function() forceOne(sound) end)
		end)
		local function watchEffect(c)
			if c:IsA("PitchShiftSoundEffect") then
				forceOne(sound)
				c:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Octave"):Connect(function() forceOne(sound) end)
			end
		end
		for _, c in ipairs(sound:GetChildren()) do watchEffect(c) end
		sound.ChildAdded:Connect(watchEffect)
	end

	onSkinChange(function(now)
		for _, sound in ipairs(sounds) do
			if now then forceOne(sound) else restoreOne(sound) end
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		local folder = ReplicatedStorage
		for _, n in ipairs({ "ClassFolders", "Biograft", "SkinAssets", "Original" }) do
			folder = folder and folder:WaitForChild(n, 10)
		end
		if not folder then
			warn("Pitch lock: couldn't find ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Biograft.SkinAssets.Original")
			return
		end
		for _, n in ipairs(NAMES) do
			local inst = folder:WaitForChild(n, 10)
			if not inst then
				warn("Pitch lock: couldn't find " .. n)
			elseif inst:IsA("Sound") then
				lock(inst)
			else -- a folder/model holding the sound(s)
				for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
					if d:IsA("Sound") then lock(d) end
				end
			end
		end
		-- not Valencina right now: put back anything an earlier execution of this script forced
		if not isValencina() then
			for _, sound in ipairs(sounds) do restoreOne(sound) end
		end
	end)
end

-- ===== Silence the game's own Biograft dialogue =====
-- ReplicatedStorage.ClassFolders.Biograft.Dialog: every line list (Intros, Kill, Assist, Victory, ...) is emptied
-- in place, so the game has nothing to say and only the custom dialogue below shows.
task.spawn(function()
	local ok, Dialog = pcall(function()
		local folder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
		for _, n in ipairs({ "ClassFolders", "Biograft", "Dialog" }) do
			folder = folder:WaitForChild(n, 10)
		end
		return require(folder)
	end)
	if not ok or type(Dialog) ~= "table" or type(Dialog.Dialogs) ~= "table" then
		warn("Silence dialogue: couldn't load the Biograft Dialog module (" .. tostring(Dialog) .. ")")
		return
	end
	-- the original line lists are kept (in env, so a second execution still has them) and put back when you
	-- switch to another skin
	local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
	env.__valDialogSaved = env.__valDialogSaved or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local saved = env.__valDialogSaved -- group table -> { key = original lines }

	local function apply(now)
		for _, group in pairs(Dialog.Dialogs) do -- Intros, Kill, Assist, Victory, Defeat, ...
			if type(group) == "table" then
				local keep = saved[group]
				if not keep then
					keep = {}
					saved[group] = keep
				end
				if now then
					local keys = {}
					for key in pairs(group) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
					for _, key in ipairs(keys) do -- Basic, Subspace, Hyperlaser, ...
						if keep[key] == nil then keep[key] = group[key] end
						group[key] = {}
					end
				else
					for key, lines in pairs(keep) do group[key] = lines end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	apply(isValencina())
	onSkinChange(apply)
end)

-- ===== Biograft Q dialogue =====
-- After the Q warning sound (valqwarn) plays, the next time the execute animation plays,
-- "Match my hatred." pops up above your head.
-- Dialogue box code is the CurrentDialog copy; tweak the settings below.
do
local WARN_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://3289150551" -- the game's Q warning sound
local EXECUTE_ANIM = "10469640735" -- animation that triggers the dialogue (only counts after the warning sound)
local DIALOG_DELAY = 0      -- seconds after that animation starts before the dialogue shows
local ARM_WINDOW = 15       -- seconds the warning sound stays "armed" waiting for the animation
local MAX_DISTANCE = 60     -- ignore warning sounds coming from farther than this (other people's Qs)
local DIALOG_COOLDOWN = 1   -- seconds; the same warning sound can't arm twice

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local NAME_TEXT = "Biograft"
local MESSAGE_TEXT = "Match my hatred."
-- Exact setup from the dump: the game's DialogBox is a normal world part, 8.25 x 4.5 studs,
-- sitting 3.125 studs straight above the head and turned (yaw only) to face the camera.
-- Your camera in that dump was 5.74 studs from your head with FOV 95.
local SCALE = 0.55          -- 1 = the game's full size. Raise/lower to resize everything.
local ZOOM_FACTOR = 1       -- 1 = keeps the same size on screen at any camera distance (no shrinking/growing)
                            -- 0 = plain world object, gets smaller as the camera pulls back
local REF_DISTANCE = 5.74   -- camera-to-head distance in the dump (only used when ZOOM_FACTOR > 0)
local HEIGHT_ABOVE_HEAD = 3.125

-- Animation
local FADE_TIME = 0.25       -- fade in / fade out duration (seconds)
local HOLD_TIME = 3          -- how long it stays fully visible before fading away
local SLIDE_DISTANCE = 0.6   -- studs (at SCALE 1) it starts below its final spot and slides up from
local MIN_SCALE, MAX_SCALE = 0.05, 40
local BASE_SCALE = 1 -- only used for the initial size before the first frame

-- Values from the dump
local PART_SIZE = Vector3.new(8.25, 4.5, 0.001)
local PIXELS_PER_STUD = 75
local GOTHAM = "rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json"

local connection, part, gui
local animToken = 0 -- bumped on cleanup so an old fade sequence can't touch a new GUI
local qShowing = false -- true while the Q-warning ("Match my hatred.") dialogue is on screen
local activeVoice -- the voice line currently playing, so the Q line can cut off any other voice

local function cleanup()
	animToken += 1
	qShowing = false
	if connection then connection:Disconnect() connection = nil end
	if part then part:Destroy() part = nil end
	if gui then gui:Destroy() gui = nil end
end

local function img(parent, props)
	local l = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.BorderSizePixel = 0
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

-- ===== voice line =====
local HATRED_FILE = "valmatchmyhatred.ogg" -- needs to be in your executor's workspace folder
local HATRED_VOLUME = 2
local AFTER_VOICE = 1        -- seconds the dialogue stays after the voice line stops
local MAX_VOICE_WAIT = 30    -- safety cap: never wait longer than this for the audio to finish

-- second dialogue: this animation plays WITHOUT the Q warning sound before it
local DISTRACTION_ANIM = "10469579892"
local DISTRACTION_TEXT = "Distraction'll bury you six-feet under!"
local DISTRACTION_FILE = "valdistraction.wav" -- needs to be in your executor's workspace folder

-- fourth dialogue: shows when you play this animation
local CONFIDENT_ANIM = "10468466383"
local CONFIDENT_TEXT = "Feeling confident today? Then parry this, asshole."
local CONFIDENT_FILE = "valconfident.wav" -- needs to be in your executor's workspace folder
local CONFIDENT_COOLDOWN = 1  -- seconds; the animation can't show the dialogue twice within this

-- fifth dialogue: shows when you play this animation
local DISPOSAL_ANIM = "10492171572"
local DISPOSAL_TEXT = "I'm sick and tired of Ticket and her meddling fools\u{2014}to hell with you all!"
local DISPOSAL_FILE = "valdisposal.wav" -- needs to be in your executor's workspace folder

-- sixth dialogue (the E dialogue): shows when you play this animation; cycles through its two lines in order
local BOOK_ANIM = "10529434738"
local BOOK_HIGH_TEXT = "I'm reading you like an open book."
local BOOK_HIGH_FILE = "valbook.wav"       -- target at high health
local BOOK_LOW_TEXT  = "What, having a hard time landing a hit?"
local BOOK_LOW_FILE  = "valhardhit.ogg"    -- target below high health (or nobody in range)
local E_BY_HEALTH = false    -- false = cycle the two lines in order; true = pick by your target's health instead (old behaviour)
local BOOK_HIGH_HEALTH = 0.5   -- (E_BY_HEALTH only) target counts as "high health" at or above this fraction of max health
local BOOK_TARGET_RANGE = 30   -- (E_BY_HEALTH only) studs; the closest enemy within this is the target
local ANIM_COOLDOWN = 1        -- seconds; the same animation can't show its dialogue twice within this

-- third dialogue: shows when you kill somebody (their Humanoid dies right after you attacked nearby)
local KILL_LINES = { -- cycled in this order, one per kill (text + its matching voice file)
	{ text = "Hahahahaha!",                         file = "valhaha.wav" },
	{ text = "I'll make mincemeat out of you all!", file = "valmincemeat.wav" },
	{ text = "And the hunt comes to a close!",      file = "valhunt.wav" },
}
local KILL_CHANCE = 1        -- 1 = every kill shows the dialogue, 0.5 = half of them, etc.
local KILL_RANGE = 40        -- studs; only deaths this close to you count as your kill
local KILL_WINDOW = 4        -- seconds after one of your attacks during which a death counts as your kill
local KILL_COOLDOWN = 2      -- seconds between kill dialogues
local KILL_Q_HOLD = 5       -- seconds after the Q warning sound during which kills stay silent (the Q execute line is coming)
local DIALOG_DEBUG = false  -- true = prints each step of the Q dialogue (warning sound, execute animation, kill held back) to the console

local voiceIds = {} -- file name -> getcustomasset id (loaded once)
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local function playVoice(file)
	if type(file) == "table" then
		-- several files back to back; the returned folder stays alive until the last one ends
		local holder = Instance.new("Folder")
		holder.Name = "DialogueVoice"
		holder.Parent = SoundService
		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(holder, MAX_VOICE_WAIT + 5)
		task.spawn(function()
			for _, f in ipairs(file) do
				if not holder.Parent then return end
				local snd = playVoice(f)
				if snd then
					while snd.Parent and holder.Parent do task.wait(0.05) end
				end
			end
			holder:Destroy()
		end)
		return holder
	end
	if not voiceIds[file] then
		local ok, res = pcall(getcustomasset, file)
		if not ok or not res then
			warn("Dialogue voice: couldn't load " .. file .. " (" .. tostring(res) .. ")")
			return
		end
		voiceIds[file] = res
	end
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.Name = "DialogueVoice"
	s.SoundId = voiceIds[file]
	s.Volume = HATRED_VOLUME
	s.Parent = SoundService
	s:Play()
	s.Ended:Once(function() s:Destroy() end)
	game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(s, MAX_VOICE_WAIT + 5)
	return s
end

local function build(character, message, voiceFile)
	if not isValencina() then return end -- another skin is equipped: no custom dialogue
	cleanup()
	qShowing = (voiceFile == HATRED_FILE) -- the kill dialogue holds back while this one is showing
	local head = character:WaitForChild("Head")

	-- Invisible carrier part (same size as the game's DialogBox, scaled)
	part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "HeadDialogBox"
	part.Size = PART_SIZE * Vector3.new(BASE_SCALE, BASE_SCALE, 1)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Parent = workspace

	gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Name = "HeadDialogGui"
	gui.Adornee = part
	gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
	gui.PixelsPerStud = PIXELS_PER_STUD / BASE_SCALE -- keeps the canvas at 618.75 x 337.5 px
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Brightness = 2
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	-- Everything lives in a CanvasGroup so the whole thing can fade with one property
	local group = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	group.Name = "Group"
	group.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	group.BorderSizePixel = 0
	group.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	group.GroupTransparency = 1 -- starts invisible
	group.ClipsDescendants = false
	group.Parent = gui

	-- Black dialog bar (9-sliced)
	local frame = img(group, {
		Name = "Frame",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.84, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.11, 25),
		ZIndex = 1,
		Image = "rbxassetid://70772335696313",
		ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
		ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
		SliceCenter = Rect.new(59, 124, 64, 124),
	})

	-- Name text on the bar
	local nameText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameText.Name = "NameText"
	nameText.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	nameText.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 19, 0.5, -13)
	nameText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	nameText.ZIndex = 2
	nameText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	nameText.BorderSizePixel = 0
	nameText.Text = NAME_TEXT
	nameText.FontFace = Font.new(GOTHAM, Enum.FontWeight.Heavy, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
	nameText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	nameText.TextSize = 25
	nameText.TextWrapped = true
	nameText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	nameText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	nameText.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Transparency = 0
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
	stroke.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter
	stroke.Parent = nameText

	-- Triangle pointer under the bar
	img(frame, {
		Name = "Tri",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.99, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.1, 0),
		ZIndex = 1,
		Image = "rbxassetid://115143460573290",
		ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
		ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch,
		ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(112, 112),
		ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(112, 112),
	})

	-- Dialogue message (exact position/size from the dump: y = 252 lands in the middle of the bar)
	local msg = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	msg.Name = "TextLabel"
	msg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	msg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 252)
	msg.Size = UDim2.new(0.81, 0, 0.85, 0)
	msg.ZIndex = 2
	msg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	msg.BorderSizePixel = 0
	msg.Text = message or MESSAGE_TEXT
	msg.FontFace = Font.new(GOTHAM, Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
	msg.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	msg.TextSize = 25
	msg.TextWrapped = true
	msg.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	msg.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	msg.Parent = group

	-- 1 = sitting below its final spot, 0 = in place
	local slide = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	slide.Value = 1

	connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not head.Parent or not part then return end
		-- Always read the CURRENT camera: the game swaps/replaces cameras, and a stale reference
		-- would freeze the distance reading (making the GUI look like it scales with zoom)
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
		local distance = (camPos - head.Position).Magnitude

		-- ZOOM_FACTOR = 0 -> s stays SCALE (same as the game); higher values grow it as the camera zooms out
		local s = SCALE * (distance / REF_DISTANCE) ^ ZOOM_FACTOR
		s = math.clamp(s, MIN_SCALE, MAX_SCALE)

		part.Size = Vector3.new(PART_SIZE.X * s, PART_SIZE.Y * s, PART_SIZE.Z)
		gui.PixelsPerStud = PIXELS_PER_STUD / s -- canvas stays 618.75 x 337.5 px

		-- Straight above the head, turned only around Y to face the camera (same as the game's DialogBox)
		local center = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, (HEIGHT_ABOVE_HEAD - slide.Value * SLIDE_DISTANCE) * s, 0)
		part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(center, Vector3.new(camPos.X, center.Y, camPos.Z))
	end)

	-- Fade in + slide up, hold, then fade away
	task.spawn(function()
		local token = animToken
		if (voiceFile or HATRED_FILE) == HATRED_FILE and activeVoice and activeVoice.Parent then
			activeVoice:Destroy() -- the Q line wins: nothing else talks over it
		end
		local voice = playVoice(voiceFile or HATRED_FILE) -- voice line plays as the box appears
		activeVoice = voice
		local fadeIn = TweenInfo.new(FADE_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		TweenService:Create(group, fadeIn, { GroupTransparency = 0 }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(slide, fadeIn, { Value = 0 }):Play()

		task.wait(FADE_TIME)
		if voice then
			-- stay until the audio finishes (the sound destroys itself when it ends), then AFTER_VOICE more seconds
			local started = os.clock()
			while voice.Parent and token == animToken and os.clock() - started < MAX_VOICE_WAIT do
				task.wait(0.05)
			end
			task.wait(AFTER_VOICE)
		else
			task.wait(HOLD_TIME) -- audio failed to load: use the normal hold time
		end
		if token ~= animToken or not group.Parent then return end -- respawned or removed

		local fadeOut = TweenInfo.new(FADE_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
		TweenService:Create(group, fadeOut, { GroupTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		task.wait(FADE_TIME)
		if token == animToken then qShowing = false end
	end)
end

local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
if env.__dialogRemoving then env.__dialogRemoving:Disconnect() end
env.__dialogRemoving = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(cleanup)
if env.__dialogSoundConn then env.__dialogSoundConn:Disconnect() end

-- the warning sound's id after valqwarn.ogg replaced it
local okW, customWarn = pcall(getcustomasset, "valqwarn.ogg")
local lastShown = -math.huge

local function isWarn(sound)
	return sound.SoundId == WARN_SOUND_ID or (okW and customWarn and sound.SoundId == customWarn)
end

local function fromMe(sound)
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return false end
	if sound:IsDescendantOf(char) then return true end
	local p = sound.Parent
	if p and p:IsA("Attachment") then p = p.Parent end
	if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
		return (p.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= MAX_DISTANCE
	end
	return true -- not attached to a part (global sound), can't tell whose it is
end

local armedAt = -math.huge

local lastConfident = -math.huge

local function trigger(sound) -- warning sound played: arm the dialogue
	if not isWarn(sound) or not fromMe(sound) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastShown < DIALOG_COOLDOWN then return end
	lastShown = now
	armedAt = now
	if DIALOG_DEBUG then print("[dialogue] Q warning sound heard, armed") end
end

-- closest living enemy within range (players or NPCs), or nil
local function findTarget(char, root, range)
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
	local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
	local seenModels = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(root.Position, range, params)) do
		local m = part
		while m and m ~= workspace do
			if m:IsA("Model") and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then break end
			m = m.Parent
		end
		if m and m ~= workspace and m ~= char and not seenModels[m] then
			seenModels[m] = true
			local hum = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local hrp = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local other = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m)
			local teammate = other and player.Team ~= nil and other.Team == player.Team
			if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and not teammate then
				local d = (hrp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
				if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = hum, d end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local animLast = {}
local function cooled(key) -- true once per ANIM_COOLDOWN for each key
	local now = os.clock()
	if animLast[key] and now - animLast[key] < ANIM_COOLDOWN then return false end
	animLast[key] = now
	return true
end

-- animations that count as "attacking" for the kill dialogue
local ATTACK_ANIMS = {
	[EXECUTE_ANIM] = true,
	[DISTRACTION_ANIM] = true,
	["10423747284"] = true, -- Combo1
	["10423750019"] = true, -- Combo2
	["10423753479"] = true, -- Combo3
	["10423756260"] = true, -- M1
}
local lastAttack = -math.huge
local lastKill = -math.huge
local lastKillLine = 0 -- index of the last kill line shown; the next kill shows the one after it
local E_LINES = {
	{ text = BOOK_HIGH_TEXT, file = BOOK_HIGH_FILE },
	{ text = BOOK_LOW_TEXT,  file = BOOK_LOW_FILE },
}
local lastELine = 0 -- index of the last E line shown; the next E shows the one after it

local seenTracks = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local function watchAnim(char)
	if env.__dialogAnimConn then env.__dialogAnimConn:Disconnect() end
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	if not hum then return end
	local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum
	env.__dialogAnimConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not char.Parent then return end
		for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
			if not seenTracks[track] then
				seenTracks[track] = true
				local id = string.match(track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId or "", "%d+")
				if id and ATTACK_ANIMS[id] then lastAttack = os.clock() end
				if id == CONFIDENT_ANIM then
					local now = os.clock()
					if now - lastConfident >= CONFIDENT_COOLDOWN then
						lastConfident = now
						task.delay(DIALOG_DELAY, function()
							if player.Character == char then build(char, CONFIDENT_TEXT, CONFIDENT_FILE) end
						end)
					end
				end
				if id == DISPOSAL_ANIM and cooled("disposal") then
					task.delay(DIALOG_DELAY, function()
						if player.Character == char then build(char, DISPOSAL_TEXT, DISPOSAL_FILE) end
					end)
				elseif id == BOOK_ANIM and cooled("book") then
					task.delay(DIALOG_DELAY, function()
						if player.Character ~= char then return end
						if E_BY_HEALTH then
							local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
							local target = root and findTarget(char, root, BOOK_TARGET_RANGE)
							local high = target and target.MaxHealth > 0
								and target.Health / target.MaxHealth >= BOOK_HIGH_HEALTH
							if high then
								build(char, BOOK_HIGH_TEXT, BOOK_HIGH_FILE)
							else
								build(char, BOOK_LOW_TEXT, BOOK_LOW_FILE)
							end
						else
							local idx = lastELine % #E_LINES + 1 -- next line in the cycle, wrapping back to the first
							lastELine = idx
							build(char, E_LINES[idx].text, E_LINES[idx].file)
						end
					end)
				end
				local armed = os.clock() - armedAt <= ARM_WINDOW
				if DIALOG_DEBUG and id == EXECUTE_ANIM then print("[dialogue] execute animation, armed =", armed) end
				if id == EXECUTE_ANIM and armed then
					armedAt = -math.huge -- one dialogue per warning
					task.delay(DIALOG_DELAY, function()
						if player.Character == char then build(char, MESSAGE_TEXT, HATRED_FILE) end
					end)
				elseif id == DISTRACTION_ANIM and not armed then
					-- the warning sound didn't come first, so it's the distraction line instead
					task.delay(DIALOG_DELAY, function()
						if player.Character == char then build(char, DISTRACTION_TEXT, DISTRACTION_FILE) end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

if player.Character then task.spawn(watchAnim, player.Character) end
if env.__dialogCharConn then env.__dialogCharConn:Disconnect() end
env.__dialogCharConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.spawn(watchAnim, c) end)


local hooked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local function hook(sound)
	if not sound:IsA("Sound") or hooked[sound] then return end
	hooked[sound] = true
	sound.Played:Connect(function() trigger(sound) end)
	task.defer(function()
		if sound.IsPlaying then trigger(sound) end
	end)
end

for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do hook(d) end
env.__dialogSoundConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(hook)

-- ===== kill dialogue: somebody near you dies right after you attacked =====
if env.__dialogKillConn then env.__dialogKillConn:Disconnect() end

local killHooked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local function hookKill(hum)
	if not hum:IsA("Humanoid") or killHooked[hum] then return end
	killHooked[hum] = true
	local victim = hum.Parent
	if victim == player.Character then return end -- your own death doesn't count
	hum.Died:Once(function()
		-- don't talk over the Q-warning dialogue: either it's on screen, or its warning sound just played
		-- and the execute animation (which shows it) hasn't started yet
		if qShowing or os.clock() - armedAt <= KILL_Q_HOLD then
			if DIALOG_DEBUG then print("[dialogue] kill dialogue held back for the Q line") end
			return
		end
		local char = player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastAttack > KILL_WINDOW or now - lastKill < KILL_COOLDOWN then return end
		local vroot = victim and victim:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not vroot or (vroot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > KILL_RANGE then return end
		local other = victim and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(victim)
		if other and player.Team ~= nil and other.Team == player.Team then return end -- teammate
		if math.random() > KILL_CHANCE then return end
		lastKill = now
		local idx = lastKillLine % #KILL_LINES + 1 -- next line in the cycle, wrapping back to the first
		lastKillLine = idx
		local line = KILL_LINES[idx]
		build(char, line.text, line.file)
	end)
end

for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do hookKill(d) end
env.__dialogKillConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(hookKill)
end
print("[Biocina] script finished loading")
